name: @windagency/valora-plugin-quality-gate
description: Asserter agent and assert command (static pre-testing quality gate) plus audit scan — detects N×M concern accumulation across sibling directories.
author: Damien TIVELET <damien@wind-agency.com>

scripts.build: tsc -b && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --external:@windagency/valora-plugin-api --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm test
